Hero.title: Websites and apps built with intent, from idea to launch.
Hero.subtitle: Lumi Beta Works helps your business — from a simple landing page to a fully custom system — built by a team that gets both the tech and your goals.

TrustedBy.heading: Trusted by businesses and institutions across industries

About.title: A Small Team That Likes Building Things Properly
About.body1: Lumi Beta Works is a small team that likes building things properly — from landing pages for local businesses to sorting out messy systems for government institutions. We're not here to sell buzzwords, just to build things people actually use.
About.body2: Got an idea (or even just a problem you can't quite name yet)? Let's talk.
About.pillar1Body: Clean code, modern Next.js/cloud architecture, and automated security practices for a platform that stays solid and easy to grow.
About.pillar2Body: Direct discussions without the red tape. Regular sprints, open work tracking, and proactive status updates every week.
About.pillar3Body: Focused on real business outcomes: higher conversion, lower bounce rates, and infrastructure that keeps operating costs down.

Services.title: Comprehensive Digital Engineering Solutions
Services.subtitle: From the first prototype to global production scale, we stay with you through every stage of your product's lifecycle.
Services.webDevBody: From landing pages to custom web and mobile apps, built with the right tech stack for the job — not just whatever's trending.
Services.uiuxBody: Research-driven interface design that's easy to use, not just nice to look at. We think through the user flow from day one, not patch it in later.
Services.qaBody: Manual and automated testing before launch, so bugs get caught by us — not by your users.
Services.consultingBody: Technical consulting to help you make the right call — choosing a tech stack, planning architecture, or just a second opinion before you build.
